verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a meta-framework is a single community comment naming SolidStart routing, and it reports that routing can be very slow with no workaround. The core library's SSR and Resources-based data loading are documented, but they are not part of a meta-framework. No first-party evidence shows SolidStart is official or describes its routing and data-fetching features, so this is a thin partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official meta-framework, evidence of its routing and data-fetching features, and positive hands-on corroboration of its performance.
